description.value: The Kitchen Dada is a sushi bar and grill on Alma Street in Vancouver's Point Grey neighbourhood, close to the Vancouver Crossing Loop route. The restaurant posts daily takeout specials and offers online ordering and delivery alongside dine-in service. It is an accessible neighbourhood spot for a quick sushi meal mid-ride.
